newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Vendex float priced at 39 guilders.
newsitem.headline: Vendex float priced at 39 guilders.

text.p: Dutch retail and business services group Vendex International NV said on Thursday it had set the price for the flotation of shares in its temporary employment services unit Vedior at 39 guilders per share.
Vedior will issue some 16.7 million shares, for which demand has been high -- the shares were 30 times oversubcribed, the company said in a statement.
It said there had been great demand from domestic and international investors a factor behind the raising of the price from the original float range of betweeen 33 and 37 guilders.
Around 60 percent of the shares have been placed in the Netherlands.
Morgan Stanley an Co will act as global co-ordinator and lead manager. The syndicate further comprises ING Barings, ABN AMRO Rothschild and Paribas Capital Markets, it said.
